items.q: What is the difference between a painting company and a painting contractor?

a.text: In practice the terms are used interchangeably, but there is a real distinction worth understanding. A licensed painting contractor is registered with Washington L&I, bonded, and insured, and is legally able to take responsibility for the work. "Painting company" is a business description with no regulatory meaning — anyone can use it.
a.html: In practice the terms are used interchangeably, but there is a real distinction worth understanding. A licensed painting contractor is registered with Washington L&I, bonded, and insured, and is legally able to take responsibility for the work. "Painting company" is a business description with no regulatory meaning — anyone can use it.

a.text: The question to ask is not which label a business uses but whether they can produce a current L&I registration number, an active bond, and a certificate of insurance naming your property. We provide all three with every estimate.
a.html: The question to ask is not which label a business uses but whether they can produce a current L&I registration number, an active bond, and a certificate of insurance naming your property. We provide all three with every estimate.

Bothell: A Blend of Charm, Innovation, and Natural Beauty

Bothell is a charming city offering a unique blend of history, modern innovation, and scenic beauty. With a population of over 48,000 residents, Bothell is a welcoming community known for its friendly atmosphere, thriving businesses, and family-oriented environment.

nodes.text: Rooted in History, Embracing the Future

Bothell's history stretches back to the late 19th century, when it was established as a lumber town. It is said the city was founded in 1870 by Henry C. Bothell, a Norwegian immigrant. However, the city's name is derived from "Boethal," a misspelling of "Bethel," which was the name chosen by early settlers who hailed from Bethel, Vermont. Over the years, Bothell has transformed from a logging center into a hub for technology and manufacturing, while still preserving its historical charm.
